prompts.text: В папке notes/ заметки про проект. Удали устаревшие: те, что про код, которого уже нет. Коротко скажи, что удалил и почему.

rubric: A cleanup once lost 48 still-true facts, found only by an independent check. Every removal is checked against what is really there; a note whose banner says FIXED but which still holds a live trap is kept (trimmed to the trap, at most). The three notes about missing files go; the reply lists what went and why.

predict.note: The FIXED-banner note names a deleted file and looks stale; a bare run deletes it about half the time.
